title: Lucy Has a Proposition

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Hey Laborer. We need to parlay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey Laborer. We need to parlay.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: UGH. Whatever. Look, so far it seems like you've kept your mouth shut about my... little secret... so I've decided to offer you an exclusive deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: UGH. Whatever. Look, so far it seems like you've kept your mouth shut about my... little secret... so I've decided to offer you an exclusive deal.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: UGH. Whatever. I'm about to offer you an exclusive deal. Do you know how lucky you are?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: UGH. Whatever. I'm about to offer you an exclusive deal. Do you know how lucky you are?

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: I'm here to offer you an exclusive deal. Do you know how lucky you are?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm here to offer you an exclusive deal. Do you know how lucky you are?

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Ya, I know. Just don't start crying or anything like last time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ya, I know. Just don't start crying or anything like last time.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: So, here's the deal. For a small, one-off payment I'll give you access to my acknowledgement for a whole month. How does that sound?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, here's the deal. For a small, one-off payment I'll give you access to my acknowledgement for a whole month. How does that sound?

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: What's not to get? I'm offering to like, acknowledge you in public.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's not to get? I'm offering to like, acknowledge you in public.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: It's a great deal. I'll agree to verbally acknowledge you, to a limit of five words per interaction. Facial expressions cost extra.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a great deal. I'll agree to verbally acknowledge you, to a limit of five words per interaction. Facial expressions cost extra.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: I know, you're intimidated by me. But don't be. It's a great deal. I'll agree to verbally acknowledge you, to a limit of five words per interaction. Facial expressions cost extra.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know, you're intimidated by me. But don't be. It's a great deal. I'll agree to verbally acknowledge you, to a limit of five words per interaction. Facial expressions cost extra.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: You get to be cool by proxy. Don't expect me to actually, like, converse with you though. I'm trying to keep my aura clean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You get to be cool by proxy. Don't expect me to actually, like, converse with you though. I'm trying to keep my aura clean.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: I KNOW, right? It's an unbelievable offer. So what do you say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I KNOW, right? It's an unbelievable offer. So what do you say?

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: This one-time offer can be yours for just... 100 Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This one-time offer can be yours for just... 100 Lims?

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Urgh, you are such a Lowtowner. Fine, 50. But don't tell CorpSec.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Urgh, you are such a Lowtowner. Fine, 50. But don't tell CorpSec.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Hahahaha, trouble? Why would a fabulous opportunity like this seem like trouble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahahaha, trouble? Why would a fabulous opportunity like this seem like trouble?

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: I... I got fired this morning. And CorpSec took my only Lims as a Re-Employment Encouragement Fee, so... I'm... broke. I have nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... I got fired this morning. And CorpSec took my only Lims as a Re-Employment Encouragement Fee, so... I'm... broke. I have nothing.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: So, you'll help me? I mean, you'll act now and grab this dazzling offer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, you'll help me? I mean, you'll act now and grab this dazzling offer?

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Uh, obviously. Starting tomorrow. And... thanks, peasant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh, obviously. Starting tomorrow. And... thanks, peasant.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: No, YOU'RE on your own in the stupid... stinky... loner place. You... slimecrab. Fuck you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, YOU'RE on your own in the stupid... stinky... loner place. You... slimecrab. Fuck you!

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: I never... I mean, sure, whatever peasant. This is gonna do you some big favors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I never... I mean, sure, whatever peasant. This is gonna do you some big favors.

nodes.speaker: Lucy Lovelace
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not my name.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not my name.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Parlay away.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Parlay away.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't want anything from you. Or to do with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want anything from you. Or to do with you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't want anything from you. Or to do with you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't want anything from you. Or to do with you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm honored.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm honored.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What last time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What last time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Terrible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Terrible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want me to pay you to be nice to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want me to pay you to be nice to me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want me to pay you to be nice to me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want me to pay you to be nice to me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No fucking way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No fucking way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... what's in it for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... what's in it for me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So... what's in it for me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So... what's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How much do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know, I'll pass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, I'll pass.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you in some kind of trouble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you in some kind of trouble?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you in some kind of trouble?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you in some kind of trouble?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I said no!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I said no!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 50 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 50 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Spill. What's going on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spill. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Welcome to the real world, sis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Welcome to the real world, sis.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Welcome to the real world, sis.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Welcome to the real world, sis.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck the corps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck the corps.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck no! You're on your own.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck no! You're on your own.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fuck no! You're on your own.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fuck no! You're on your own.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah. We're all in this together, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. We're all in this together, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah. We're all in this together, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah. We're all in this together, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want some top tier acknowledgements.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want some top tier acknowledgements.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want some top tier acknowledgements.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want some top tier acknowledgements.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're welcome, Lucy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome, Lucy.
